title: Primeval Whisperer
description: You can communicate freely with wild creatures. When you **Sense the Motive** **of a wild creature**, no matter the result you may ask them an extra question, even on a 6-. When you **Pull the Strings** of a wild creature, if your approach aligns with their desires or instincts, roll with **adv**.

submoves.title: Note
submoves.description: A "wild creature" can be an animal, plant, fungus, or other non-sapient living being. It isn't a "thing" like a rock or a river, but it could be a tree or an insect. If it's unclear whether something is a wild creature, the GM has the final say.

title: Call of the Wild
description: When you **call out to the wilderness for aid**, choose a suitable type of wild creature for your current environment and roll+CHA.

outcomes.text: That wild creature arrives to help you for the scene as an allied NPC; choose two.
bullets: A pack or group of them arrive instead of just one
They accompany you for a period after this scene ends
They cause no collateral damage or turmoil while here
They intimidate or distract an enemy upon their arrival

outcomes.text: You instead draw nature's ire or hunger; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Raised by Wolves
description: Choose one type of wild creature __wldct:Bears, eagles, wolves__. By default, they treat you as a friend and your companions as allies by association. When you **spend time with your chosen wild creature**, choose one if alone or two if with another PC.

bullets: **exchange gifts** — Regain a spent use of an item
**listen to their stories** — Learn about a nearby danger or obstacle as if you rolled a 7-9 to **Spout Lore**

title: Rumour From the Earth
description: When you **Unearth Secrets** or **Sense Motive** **by questioning nearby wild creatures**, you may roll+CHA.

title: Together as One
description: When you **mark a wild creature with blood, mud, or dirt**, erase previous marks, then you can share in their senses as if they were yours (and vice versa), no matter what distance separates you.
